verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler has a dedicated Patent Counseling & Prosecution group page. It states the firm's patent attorneys identify valuable inventions, prepare and prosecute patent applications, and provide opinion and counseling work for clients from startups to Fortune 100s. A documented group page satisfies the story's 'named practitioners or group pages' condition. Missing for 10: explicit portfolio-strategy or defensible-position language beyond invention identification, named patent practitioners, independent corroboration of the practice.
